releases.notes:
# DonutSMP Shop

This mod brings back the classic `/shop` menu as a clean client-side screen for DonutSMP. Open `/shop`, browse the menu, and get to the item you want faster with a simple interface that feels close to the original server experience.

## Features

- Restores the old DonutSMP shop menu
- Clean, vanilla-style interface
- Fast category and item navigation
- Fully client-side

**Important:** This mod only helps you navigate the shop. All items are still obtained normally on the server.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.11
- Fabric
- Java 21

## Security

This release is built from the public source code in this repository. It does not make HTTP requests and does not access account tokens or browser data.
